entry.title: New: Bill 206 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
REPEALS ORDINANCE NO. 84-39 AND AMENDS CHAPTER 14, ARTICLE 8, SECTION 14-44, OF THE HAWAI‘I COUNTY CODE 1983 (2016 EDITION, AS AMENDED), RELATING TO NUCLEAR ENERGY

Repeals Ordinance No. 84-39 enacted in 1984 to specify that United States military operations are exempt from and not to be impeded by prohibitions on the transportation or storage of radioactive material.
